subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB523
title: Allows a student with a disability to use transitional services available to students without disabilities when the student's parent or foster parent revokes consent for, or objects to, the student's placement on an abbreviated school day program.
headline: SB 523 did not pass

claims.text: SB 523 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 523 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
